_about: Classifies KiCad DRC violation types into RESPONSIBILITY buckets so a benchmark can tell whether the ROUTER improved a board vs whether errors come from placement/fixture/zone strategy. Without this, a raw DRC total hides progress: routing can clear 8 unconnected nets and add 1 zone-thermal issue, and the total looks 'worse'. Pure data — retype a category with no code change. Types are kicad-cli's `type` strings.
_categories_doc: routing = the router's own responsibility (copper paths/vias must never short or under-clear). manufacturing = DFM/zone strategy (silk, mask, thermal spokes, slivers) — fixed by re-pour / silk cleanup, NOT the router. placement = footprint arrangement (courtyards, holes) — fixed by place/DRU. fixture = invalid input geometry (bad outline, off-board). connectivity = ratsnest (unconnected) — routing REDUCES these, so a drop is progress.
